comparison.objective: Turn an amplifier volume down, plug in a cable, then restore the prior setting; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Remember and restore a knob setting while stabilizing a light device and inserting a plug versus simultaneous screw/nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Cable inserted only at zero volume and knob restored to its prior value versus mechanically locked angle retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: This is a relevant setting-retention concept, but it tests sequential memory and safe connector insertion, not physical locknut preservation.
